summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-11-20 ~ 2026-11-22）

- 🔧 PCI 新增 pci_power_t 辅助函数，统一 x86 early quirk 与 PCI 核心的电源状态判断（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ arm64 校验和新增拷贝与 Internet 校验融合例程，减少数据遍历开销（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ IPI 发送前加入内存屏障，保证 x86 TLB/LDT 刷新前的写顺序在多 CPU 下可见（[Scheduling](#subsystem-Scheduling)）
- ✨ VFS 新增 inode 迭代接口，drop_caches/quota/GFS2 改用批量遍历以降低 superblock 锁争用（[Filesystem & Storage](#subsystem-Filesystem%20%26%20Storage)）
- ✨ 为每个 NUMA 节点引入私有节点隔离机制，使大页与设备内存可归属私有节点、减少跨节点干扰（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）
- 🛡 修复 keyctl_pkey_e_d_s 向用户缓冲区写越界，消除可被触发的内核内存破坏（[Security](#subsystem-Security)）

## Drivers
- `perf` `other` ：发布 7.3.6-rc2 稳定补丁审查队列，覆盖文档、DT 绑定与多驱动修复。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120055248.913352689@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` ：发布 6.18.65-rc2 稳定补丁审查队列，汇总多驱动与文档修复。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120055114.182757740@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` ：发布 6.6.163-rc2 稳定补丁审查队列，覆盖时钟、显示与文档等修复。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120055324.975889935@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` ：发布 6.12.119-rc2 稳定补丁审查队列，汇总驱动与 DT 绑定修复。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120054951.366579794@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` ：发布 6.1.193-rc2 稳定补丁审查队列，覆盖 PCI、时钟与显示相关修复。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120055200.707545519@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` ：发布 5.15.226-rc2 稳定补丁审查队列，汇总媒体、电源与文件系统修复。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120055015.328810133@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` ：发布 5.10.275-rc2 稳定补丁审查队列，覆盖 PCI、cgroup 与驱动修复。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120054906.397973290@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` ：DRM 修复集覆盖 accel/amdgpu 等，修复 7.4-rc 周期内多个显示与加速器问题。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/CAPM=9ty1FBin9jGz8CoumpTTBOe-LB_Qs5RNn_uMJMbMGTYmyQ@mail.gmail.com/)
- arm64 增加 LG V60 ThinQ(timelm)设备树及面板/触控支持，扩展 SM8250 机型覆盖。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120155450.7719-1-rofikcoga@gmail.com/)

## Architecture
- PCI 增加 pci_power_t 辅助函数，供 x86 early quirk 与 PCI 核心统一电源状态判断（v4）。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121130936.53191-2-habilerenturker@hotmail.com/)
- PCI 增加 pci_power_t 辅助函数，统一电源状态比较并替换相关 quirk（v3）。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121125811.50315-1-habilerenturker@hotmail.com/)
- `perf` 增加 SoCFPGA FCS RNG 驱动，为 Altera 平台提供硬件随机数源。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795167624.git.hang.suan.wang@altera.com/)
- `perf` Coresight ETM 可按 PMU 事件脉冲外部输出，扩展 arm64 性能分析触发能力。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795182850.git.aaupov@fb.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` ：ARM/ARM64/LoongArch/XTENSA 将硬件断点通知延迟到 task_work，避免上下文异常。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120144553.TjgAd_G6@linutronix.de/)
- `perf` arm64 校验和新增拷贝与 Internet 校验融合例程，减少数据遍历。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120220330.1067165-1-demyansh@gmail.com/)
- `perf` arm64 Apple M3 系列补充 CPU 调频与 OPP 表，启用频率/电压动态调节。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-m3-cpufreq-opp-v1-0-42a0c07c48a4@gmail.com/)
- `perf` arm64 Rockchip rkvdec 增加 VDPU346 变体支持，扩展 H.264/H.265 硬解覆盖（v6）。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795279680.git.daniel@makrotopia.org/)
- `perf` arm64 Rockchip rkvdec 增加 VDPU346 变体支持，扩展硬解覆盖（v5）。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795191822.git.daniel@makrotopia.org/)
- `perf` arm64 Allwinner 增加 KickPi K5C 板级 DT，扩展 A133 平台支持。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-k5c-dt-v1-v1-0-d9681df67bc0@gmail.com/)
- 另有 107 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121164453.26-1-26rote@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-smmu_interconnect_addition-v4-0-be30526391d9@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-smmu_interconnect_addition-v4-0-cab8ee8be0b3@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-qce-fix-self-tests-v12-0-b5a2a44bc5ae@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120174751.49247-1-afd@ti.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-enable-byte-cntr-for-ctcu-v24-0-2d792c6b4819@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-iep2-v4-0-760cf25f322b@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-iep2-v3-0-e94eb9f629d2@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-molokai-soc-v3-0-403d763685d9@yahoo.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-shikra-el2-v7-0-9d9000eb50d4@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-shikra-el2-v7-0-b19595f24eb1@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-dcif-upstreaming-v13-0-966ac248773f@oss.nxp.com/) 等 107 项

## Scheduling
- `perf` IPI 发送前加入内存屏障，保证多 CPU 下 x86 TLB/LDT 刷新前的写顺序可见，含 x86 tlb/ldt 适配。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120224758.04F70CD8@davehans-spike.ostc.intel.com/)
- 引入 fd 绑定的进程 closure 与配套 syscall，改动 20 多个架构 syscall 表及用户态文档。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121000844.1863324-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` ：修正 deadline 带宽记账与相关锁路径，覆盖 cpuset、rtmutex 与 selftests，减少带宽泄漏与错算。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795207232.git.mathieu.desnoyers@efficios.com/)
- 重建 sched domain 时跳过离线/非活动组的逐组计算，降低大核数系统的 domain 重建开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-bug-sched-fair-offline-active-v3-0-325e9eefa56d@linux.dev/)
- sched_ext idle 不再把同步唤醒的 wakee 叠在更高调度类任务之后，并补充对应 selftest。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-scx-fix75-v1-0-254f782ff9b0@gmail.com/)
- psi 权限检查改用初始 user namespace 的 CAP_SYS_RESOURCE，避免命名空间内越权操作。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120085135.40368-1-dennylin0707@gmail.com/)
- 修正 fair.c 中注释缺失的右括号，仅文档性清理，无行为变化。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121114129.1443346-2-manuelebnerli@mailbox.org/)
- `bugfix` ：修复 uclamp 与 static key 非原子使能之间的竞态，涉及 fair/rt/ext/idle 各路径的启用检查。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121041507.39582-1-qyousef@layalina.io/)
- `bugfix` ：修正 group load 记账并改进 imbalance 计算，缓解 CPU 间任务分布不均与负载漂移。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120014946.1355234-5-srikar@linux.ibm.com/)
- `bugfix` ：同系列另一版本，修正 load 记账并优化 imbalance 计算，改善负载均衡收敛。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120003534.1339296-5-srikar@linux.ibm.com/)
- 另有 8 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120095559.429515-1-xavier.qyxia@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121031329.240177-1-longman@redhat.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120105822.7770-1-lshahed@amazon.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120095819.1009260-1-vincent.guittot@linaro.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120171658.Cf9qIU-Y@linutronix.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120051742.50358-1-fushuai.wang@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120065559.3979434-1-rhkrqnwk98@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120054913.3795562-1-rhkrqnwk98@gmail.com/)

## Observability
- platform/x86 IFS 支持分组式 In-Field Scan 与 Diamond Rapids，新增 stop_machine 接口及 ftrace 事件 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120175658.1147030-1-ehab.ababneh@intel.com/)
- `perf` 采用内核 compiler-context-analysis.h 注解，减少误报并改善热路径编译优化 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121065813.4143649-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 追踪子系统集中修复 fgraph/ftrace、ring buffer、事件过滤与 hist 触发、用户事件路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121075739.3ad033bf@fedora/)
- `perf` `bugfix` cpupower frequency-set 修复 use-after-free 与陈旧频率上限 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-cpupower-freq-set-use-after-free-v4-1-928675d53a23@mailbox.org/)
- `perf` 引入按环境区分的 PMU、metric 事件共享与录制事件 metric，扩展 arm64/x86 测试 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120221332.2245191-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` 新增 perf sysinfo 子命令，探测并汇总 PMU 能力与寄存器信息 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120222615.2291168-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `other` script 改为惰性加载符号，降低大符号表场景的启动内存与延迟 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-perf-symbol-memory-send-v8-0-370561cbb5a7@uber.com/)
- `perf` `other` 符号表改为有序数组并由 DSO 持有生命周期，缩小内存占用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121071651.67118-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 引入 perf 覆盖率测试框架，并修复其发现的 annotate 等路径缺陷 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121032052.1392234-1-acme@kernel.org/)
- `perf` 新增 CAN J1939 套接字与传输层 selftests [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-j1939-selftests-v5-0-fdf4c242a37e@pengutronix.de/)
- 另有 34 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121195404.2775730-1-mic@digikod.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795262546.git.chaosheng.qu.linux@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-bperf-attr-map-err-v1-1-b12b6b550273@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121003403.2928928-1-ihor.solodrai@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-kselftest-run-timer-v2-0-9802690a370b@xs4all.nl/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120012553.3745742-1-jrhilke@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121182217.4609-1-emmaonana18@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120094934.979574-1-sunshaojie@kylinos.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-bpf-ringbuf-fixes-v3-0-ff7ca15d6c37@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/c2b42261-71e8-46c1-b847-16b12ee81676@intel.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120061903.98141-1-zhujun2@cmss.chinamobile.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-bpf-raw-tp-regs-preempt-v3-0-ec109009a5d2@gmail.com/) 等 34 项

## Networking
- [feature] 新增 Amlogic A9 CAN-FD 控制器驱动、绑定和 arm64 DTS 节点。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120080820.3340646-1-zelong.dong@amlogic.com/)
- [feature] 新增 SoC-e Ethernet switch IP 的 DSA/MDIO/MFD 支持，扩展交换芯片平台。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-devel-vstrassheim-soce-dsa-ml-v5-0-5de9225715e6@linutronix.de/)
- `perf` [perf feature] 为 seccomp 引入经典 BPF 过滤器缓存，复用已编译过滤程序，降低重复安装/匹配开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795139109.git.xukuohai@huaweicloud.com/)
- `perf` `other` [perf other] 为 ceph/libceph 同步等待加边界，网络中断后加快恢复，减少长等待。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120073431.53636-1-ionut.nechita@windriver.com/)
- `perf` `other` [perf other] 调整 dst_entry 中 tclassid 与 __rcuref 布局，避免同缓存行伪共享，降低并发更新开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120061604.3676605-1-jiebin.sun@intel.com/)
- `perf` `other` [perf other] tcp_metrics 用 SipHash 散列目的地址，降低哈希碰撞和潜在攻击面。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120211711.75786-1-juanagusnicco@gmail.com/)
- [feature] 让 TCP fixed-ID 标志保留在所属报文头，修正隧道/卸载场景下标志位置。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795284858.git.julius@bairaktaris.de/)
- [feature] printk 引入不安全刷新策略，netconsole/panic 等路径可按策略控制刷新行为。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121163557.963029-1-john.ogness@linutronix.de/)
- `bugfix` [bugfix] 修复 sctp_sendmsg 释放路径与 peeloff 的竞争，避免关联被提前释放。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120050108.426545-1-xuehaolin@uniontech.com/)
- [feature] 新增 net.ipv4.tcp_l3mdev_exempt_ports，允许指定端口绕过 L3 master 绑定检查。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-tcp-l3mdev-exempt-ports-v1-0-ccc2a3a6cd09@nexthop.ai/)
- 另有 97 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795166508.git.ralf@mandelbit.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120032327.18375-1-sunwenbo@cmss.chinamobile.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121120121.576-1-viennaoffh@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-msft-filter-monitors-v1-0-8192f0c0791a@pm.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121170346.12440-1-25031212351@stu.xidian.edu.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121133242.6550-1-25031212351@stu.xidian.edu.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-sun8i-emac-mux-uaf-v4-0-57eba8915f25@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120035521.2098757-1-pkfxxxing@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120174341.35873-1-juanagusnicco@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-bluetooth-objects-candidate-0218-v8-da37c8a6b33c9d2d8efc-0@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121065625.27934-1-18983559317@163.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120214439.44958-1-astellman@stellman-greene.com/) 等 97 项

## Filesystem & Storage
- nvmem 完成 provider 与 layout 解绑和生命周期管理，避免 layout 访问已释放的 provider [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-submit-nvmem-provider-lifetime-v1-v3-0-523610652402@gmail.com/)
- `perf` VFS 新增 inode 迭代接口，drop_caches/quota/GFS2 改用批量遍历，降低 superblock 锁争用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120031305.3561045-1-huangsj@hygon.cn/)
- `perf` ceph 拆分 mdsc->mutex 争用路径，kclient 元数据吞吐由 692k/s 提升到 722k/s [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-ceph-mdsc-mutex-optimization-v7-0-a4eee70e0038@clyso.com/)
- `perf` scsi bsg 在 end-I/O 阶段释放 io_uring 请求，减少完成路径上的同步等待 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/scsi-pool-v5.1795249365940711260.0.x-professor@outlook.com/)
- `perf` exfat 新增 EXFAT_IOC_COMBINE ioctl，把文件簇接到另一个文件尾部，实现零拷贝拼接 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121174315.500249-1-shaopei_1012@163.com/)
- `perf` `other` eventpoll 先检查事件掩码再取 ep->lock，减少无谓加锁 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120233037.124956-1-jiayuan.chen@linux.dev/)
- ceph 跨客户端串行化 O_APPEND 写入，修复多客户端并发追加的数据错乱 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-ceph-append-excl-v1-0-5870375edeb8@clyso.com/)

- jbd2 恢复流程新增元数据校验钩子，供文件系统在重放时拒绝不可能的组空闲簇计数 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120025459.70290-2-zhaogongyi@bytedance.com/)

## Memory
- 为每个 NUMA 节点引入私有节点隔离机制，并新增 DAX/内存热插拔与 cpuset 文档；大页/设备内存可归属私有节点，减少跨节点干扰 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-private_nodes_v6-v1-0-74f5f9a115c2@gourry.net/)
- `perf` 统一 compound page 的 memmap 初始化路径，覆盖 hugetlb、CMA、vmemmap 稀疏区，减少重复初始化开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120100856.16929-1-songmuchun@bytedance.com/)
- 迁移大 folio 时批量恢复 PTE，避免逐页处理，缩短迁移期间的页表操作耗时 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120032949.2036731-1-chenwandun1@gmail.com/)
- 将 Rust 的 C 辅助函数导出放入独立命名空间，避免符号污染并简化模块构建 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-rust-helper-namespace-v2-1-14315658f59e@gmail.com/)
- `other` memcg OOM 扫描不再跳过已退出 leader 的进程，避免漏选可回收任务 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121073222.834282-1-zhanxusheng1024@gmail.com/)
- `other` hugetlb 提前分配较大的 CMA 页，降低后续碎片化导致大页分配失败的概率 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120074701.48298-1-qi.zheng@linux.dev/)
- `bugfix` 修正 fork 后 ksm_zero_pages 计数丢失，配套文档与 selftest 更新 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120074230.40269-1-xu.xin@linux.dev/)
- `bugfix` 修正 NR_BALLOON_PAGES 的两处统计偏差，涉及 balloon 核心与 vmw_balloon 驱动 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-b4-balloon_nr_pages-v1-0-d8944b587819@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` shmem 不再对未计费 folio 使用其 memcg，避免错误的 memcg 归属 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120195057.50031-1-mason@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` shrinker 调试 seq 缓冲溢出时停止计数，防止越界写入 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120110538.3256962-1-wangxuewen_ky@163.com/)
- 另有 2 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120083707.296481-1-zhanxusheng1024@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121025626.75981-1-evanfengff@gmail.com/)

## Clocks & Timers
- 新增 Toshiba TC9564 时钟与复位驱动及绑定、Kconfig、门控 ID 头文件，补齐该芯片的时钟控制。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120183212.1264522-1-elder@riscstar.com/)
- ACPI 6.5 固定时钟支持：clkdev 与 acpi_platform 联动注册，使 ACPI 平台在没有 DT 时也能获得 fixed-clock，让更多平台能启动。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120125722.209609-1-paul.cercueil@bootlin.com/)
- 新增通用 GPIO 门控时钟驱动 clk-gpio 及绑定文档，实现用 GPIO 使能并门控时钟，便于复用现有通用框架。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-feature-clock-guard-v11-0-00c633a667a2@bruker.com/)
- 扩展 Airoha en7523 SCU 驱动支持 AN7583 时钟与复位，并补充绑定和 reset 头文件。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120233535.164885-1-ansuelsmth@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` rp1 允许时钟 provider 在探测失败后重新探测，修复依赖顺序导致的时钟不可用。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121181650.143474-1-joshuacov@gmail.com/)
- Renesas r9a06g032 增加复位控制器以清除 MII 转换器复位，同时更新 DTS 与绑定。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-rzn1-miic-resets-v2-0-f1cfa678615b@reliablecontrols.com/)
- 新增 Amlogic S7 PLL 与外设时钟控制器驱动、DT 绑定及 clk-pll 共用改动，支持 S7 平台时钟树。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-upstream-s7-clk-v2-0-856cece3b9f2@baylibre.com/)
- 新增 Qualcomm Molokai GPU 时钟控制器驱动与 sm8450-gpucc 绑定，支持该平台 GPU 时钟。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-molokai-gpucc-v2-0-e84a0869693f@yahoo.com/)
- 另有 7 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-master-v14-0-112cfd63438d@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-gcc_i2c_tsc_support-v3-0-e631872e670b@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-sg2042-efi-rtc-v2-0-6d087e03e4e8@iscas.ac.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-b4-mt7629-rtc-v2-0-cd877cd496ae@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-rzg2l-coupled-clk-v1-1-c38c8299c176@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-ux500-clk-power-upll-v1-1-431041f317ba@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120153723.85232-1-Herman@octarion.eu/)

## Virtualization
- KVM x86 MMU 对非 guest_memfd 的私有 GFN 不再尝试巨页恢复，避免私有内存的映射层级被错误回退 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-gmem-fix-gmem-max-mapping-level-v1-1-108788914fe8@google.com/)
- 新增 virtio-media 驱动 v12，含 scatterlist 构建、会话与 ioctl 实现，并导出 UAPI 头供用户态使用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121025007.3445723-1-briandaniels@google.com/)
- virtio-media 驱动 v11 修订版，提供同一套驱动与 UAPI 文件的早期实现，已被后续版本取代 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120215916.3149345-1-briandaniels@google.com/)
- `bugfix` vfio core 修复 QEMU checkpoint/restore 下的 KVM 引用泄漏，同步调整 group、PCI、kvmgt 与 vfio_ap 的引用路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120154730.882393-1-andrey.drobyshev@virtuozzo.com/)
- mshv 在 hypercall 反复失败时仍处理完成项，避免主机侧请求长期悬挂、资源无法回收 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120020858.3597446-1-mrathor@linux.microsoft.com/)
- `bugfix` vhost/net 修正忙轮询时对接收队列的判断条件，避免误判队列导致收包处理异常 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/1B3A1B72438119BC+20261120033824.681219-1-raoxu@uniontech.com/)

## Security
- LSM 新增 pre-lookup 路径名打开检查钩子，在路径解析前介入，为 BPF LSM 提供更早的访问控制点。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120094820.11929-1-tasos.papagiannnis@gmail.com/)
- `perf` `other` zswap 引入压缩批处理框架，acompress 支持一次提交多个请求，减少调用与锁开销，提升 store 吞吐。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120041906.5785-1-kanchanapsridhar2026@gmail.com/)
- KEYS 同主题的初版提交，以 key semaphore 串行化 construct_key 类型解引用，后续由 v2 接替。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121112853.2175119-1-tristmd@gmail.com/)
- `other` keys 使 key 实例化与 keyctl_chown_key 串行执行，消除并发改属主与实例化之间的竞态窗口。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121111246.3478-1-enscrpt@pm.me/)
- `other` KEYS 用 key semaphore 保护 construct_key 的类型解引用，避免并发实例化时读到被改写的类型指针（v2）。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121125039.2532663-1-tristmd@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` crypto: af_alg 在零长度 final 消息时唤醒等待者，修复接收方可能一直阻塞无法返回的问题。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120083244.1156396-1-maguicai@kylinos.cn/)
- `bugfix` KEYS 修复 keyctl_pkey_e_d_s 向用户缓冲区写越界，消除可被触发的内核内存破坏。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120022447.789625-1-maguicai@kylinos.cn/)

## Core Kernel
- Rust 新增 xarray entry API 与预加载机制，配套 C 侧辅助及 SLUB sheaf 接口，供驱动安全操作指针条目 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-xarray-entry-send-v6-0-1f69d7385f70@kernel.org/)
- rcutorture 用 CPU 密集型读者重写 RCU 优先级提升测试，新增内核参数与 BUSTED-BOOST 配置，扩大测试覆盖 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121153552.68941-1-jfern@kernel.org/)
- `other` Landlock 在 TSYNC 等待期间不再持有 exec_update_lock，避免长时间阻塞其他任务的 exec [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120151554.2651743-1-mic@digikod.net/)
- `other` swiotlb 受限 DMA 池的 slot 数组改用 kvzalloc，避免大块连续物理内存分配失败 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-upstream2-swiotlb-rmem-kvzalloc-v2-1-cc5732dddb6b@gmail.com/)
- `other` swiotlb 受限 DMA 池 slot 数组改用 kvzalloc 的初版提交，思路同上 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-upstream2-swiotlb-rmem-kvzalloc-v1-1-1c5f9b503223@gmail.com/)
- `other` liveupdate 删除 luo_session_ioctl 中与上层重复的下界检查，简化参数校验路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120075252.684604-1-zengxiaotao@kylinos.cn/)
- `other` kunit 属性过滤代码小幅整理，去掉冗余逻辑与重复判断 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120015020.40658-1-yijiangshan@kylinos.cn/)
- `bugfix` asn1_encoder 修复 OID 分量为零时编码错误，避免生成非法编码结果 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/tencent_AFE15D698FFD4F18E16A6EF7CDA002D69806@qq.com/)
- `bugfix` refscale 修复 typesafe_cleanup 中可能的空指针解引用导致的 oops [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120100453.5826-1-qiang.zhang@linux.dev/)
